scholarships.title: MOFA Scholarship Program
scholarships.official_source: United Arab Emirates Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA)

existing.description: The UAE Ministry of Foreign Affairs runs a scholarship programme for Emirati students to study a Bachelor's degree at one of the world's top universities approved by MOFA, specialising in fields that meet the needs of the UAE diplomatic corps. MOFA states in its FAQ that the programme covers all tuition costs in accordance with the programme's policies, and the applicant must already hold an unconditional direct academic acceptance from an approved university indicating the programme start and end dates and the total cost. The programme is not a general study-abroad scholarship: it carries a service obligation, requiring the holder to join the MOFA diplomatic corps for a period equivalent to the number of academic years covered by the scholarship and to join the Anwar Gargash Diplomatic Academy upon graduation.
eligibility: Must be UAE nationals (holders of UAE passports and family book)

Must be between 17 and 21 years old and have legal guardian approval; the FAQ states previous-year high school graduates may apply provided the applicant is between 17 and 22 years old at the time of application
Must provide a certificate of Good Conduct and Behavior from the relevant official authorities in the UAE

Must have a high school diploma: General Stream, General Technical Stream, American System and other systems require 90% and above; Advanced Stream, Advanced Technical Stream and SABIS System require 85% and above; Elite Stream and Advanced Science Program require 80% and above
British System / IGCSE: completion of five IGCSE/GCSE subjects with a grade of B or higher and two AS/A Level subjects with a grade of C or higher
International Baccalaureate (IB): completion of the IB Diploma with a minimum average of 30 points or higher
School transcript listing all related instructional subjects
Applicants must have an IELTS (Academic Module) score of 6.5 or above, or equivalent
Applicants must hold an acceptance letter from an approved university listed and approved by MOFA
Applicants must agree to study a third language, if required
Male applicants must provide a certificate of exemption or completion of national service
Applicants must agree to join the UAE diplomatic corps at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for a period equivalent to the number of academic years covered by the scholarship
Applicants must agree to join Anwar Gargash Diplomatic Academy (AGDA) upon graduation
Applicants must provide parental consent to join the scholarship program
Applicants cannot choose a university outside the MOFA-approved list
existing.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be UAE nationals holding a UAE passport and family book, aged between 17 and 21 with legal guardian approval, hold a high school diploma meeting the published percentage thresholds, have an IELTS Academic score of 6.5 or equivalent, and hold an acceptance letter from a MOFA-approved university.
benefits: Place in the Anwar Gargash Diplomatic Academy's Post-Graduate Diploma in UAE Diplomacy and International Relations after the Bachelor's degree
Subsequent appointment to the diplomatic corps at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs after fulfilling graduation requirements
coverage: All tuition costs, in accordance with the program's policies
requirements: Register through the MOFA scholarship service form
Attach the required documents in PDF format upon registration
Hold an unconditional direct academic acceptance in a specific specialty, institution and country for the MOFA scholarship, indicating the program start and end dates and the total cost
Pass the tests and interviews that form part of the admission procedure
Pass the mandatory interview, which applicants must successfully complete to fulfil the scholarship requirements
documents: Valid passport copy, including the last page showing the unified number
Transcripts copy for grades Ten, Eleven and the first term of grade Twelve (first or last term if available), attested by relevant entities as applicable

Direct academic acceptance, unconditional to other requirements, in a specific specialty, institution and country for the MoFA scholarship, indicating the program start and end dates and the total cost
Medical examination certificate, on the form available in the application and certified by any government hospital or medical center within the UAE
National service status certificate for male students
Certificate from a local bank under the student's name indicating the IBAN, after obtaining final approval (if the applicant is accepted)
Parental approval for students under 22 years of age (according to the Personal Affairs Law)
English language certificates with scores for one of the accepted tests
Certificate of Good Conduct and Behavior
existing.english_requirement: IELTS (Academic Module) 6.5 or above, or equivalent. The FAQ states applicants must achieve a minimum score of 6.5 in Academic IELTS or an equivalent score in TOEFL.
application_method: Obtain an unconditional direct academic acceptance from a MOFA-approved university for a specific specialty, institution and country, showing programme start and end dates and the total cost
Prepare the required documents in PDF format
Register through the MOFA scholarship service form at https://www.mofa.gov.ae/services/forms/scholarship
Upload the required documents with the registration
Complete the tests and interviews that form part of the admission procedure, including the mandatory interview
Track application status through program notifications; final admission results are communicated by email or SMS
If already submitted and an amendment is needed, call +971 80044444 so the existing application can be removed and a new, updated application submitted
existing.selection_notes: The admission procedure includes a number of tests, interviews and additional conditions. The interview is a mandatory part of the admission process and applicants must successfully pass it to complete the scholarship requirements. The review and final approval process typically takes between 3 to 5 months, with applicants notified of updates by email or SMS.
existing.best_fit: Emirati nationals aged 17 to 21 (up to 22 at the time of application) with a high school diploma meeting the published percentage thresholds, an IELTS Academic score of 6.5 or equivalent, and an unconditional offer from a MOFA-approved university, who are willing to enter the UAE diplomatic corps.
existing.notes: This is a service-obligation scholarship, not free money to study anywhere: applicants must agree to join the UAE diplomatic corps at MOFA for a period equivalent to the number of academic years covered by the scholarship, and must agree to join the Anwar Gargash Diplomatic Academy upon graduation. Only UAE nationals may apply, and only MOFA-approved universities are eligible, so an applicant who already has an offer from an unlisted institution cannot use this programme. Male applicants must have completed or been exempt from national service. Applicants who defer or want to change their major or country of study must inform the relevant programme officer at the Ministry and notify the cultural attaché in the country of study. The published page states that MOFA covers all tuition costs but does not publish any statement on living costs, accommodation, airfare or a stipend.
existing.application_period: No published opening or closing dates. Applicants register through the MOFA scholarship service form and are notified of results by email or SMS; amendments after submission are handled through the call centre at +971 80044444.
existing.deadline_display: No application deadline is published on the program page; applications are registered through the online service and the review and final approval process typically takes between 3 to 5 months, with updates communicated by email or SMS
